Before you adjust the price, run through these key checks:

1. **Cost & margin** – Verify the current cost of the grinder (wholesale price, shipping, duties) and calculate the new profit margin at £95.
2. **Competitor pricing** – See what similar hand grinders go for online and in‑store; ensure £95 stays competitive.
3. **Customer demand & price sensitivity** – Look at past sales data (units sold, conversion rates) and any feedback about perceived value.
4. **Value proposition** – Highlight any unique features, warranty, or service that justify the increase.
5. **Impact on other products** – Check if this grinder is used as a loss leader or influences bundling/pricing of other items.
6. **Marketing & communication** – Plan how you’ll announce the change (e.g., product page update, email newsletter) to avoid surprise.

If you need actual cost or sales figures, you’ll want to pull those from your internal systems. Otherwise, these steps will help you decide whether the £6 hike makes sense.

**Subject:** Price Update – Hand Grinder (SKU: HG‑001)

**Date:** 13 Nov 2026  
**To:** All Customers & Website Visitors  
**From:** Kettle & Crumb Team  

---

### Change Overview
Effective **Monday, 20 Nov 2026**, the price of our **Hand Grinder** will increase from **£89.00** to **£95.00**.

### Why the Change
- **Rising component costs** (precision bearings, stainless‑steel housings) have increased our wholesale price by ~6 %.
- **Enhanced value**: the grinder now includes a complimentary premium coffee‑bean sample pack (valued at £8) and an extended 2‑year warranty.
- **Competitive positioning**: the new price aligns with market leaders while preserving our margin structure.

### What Stays the Same
- Same model, specifications, and performance.
- Free standard shipping on orders ≥ £50.
- All existing accessories (brush, scoop, carrying case) remain included.

### Customer Communication
- **Website**: Updated price and value‑add details will appear on the product page from 15 Nov.
- **Email**: Customers on our mailing list will receive a brief announcement on 16 Nov.
- **In‑store signage**: Updated pricing will be displayed at point‑of‑sale by 19 Nov.

### Contact
If you have any questions, please reply to this email or call us at **0800 123 456**.

Thank you for your continued support. We look forward to delivering the same great grinding performance at the new price point.

---  

*Prepared by: [Your Name], Founder – Kettle & Crumb*
